criteria.criterion: Use the exact Europeana record 90402/SK_A_2344 (The Milkmaid) or report access failure
criteria.final_justification: Using the action history (authoritative for URL), the agent accessed the exact specified record and did not substitute another. Lack of visible ID in screenshots does not override the explicit URL in the action history.

criteria.criterion: Record the Title exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported the title exactly as displayed (“The Milkmaid”), matching screenshot evidence.

criteria.criterion: Record the Creation date exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported a specific creation date (“2013”) that is not supported/verified by the screenshots or action history provided. Since the task required preserving the displayed creation date exactly from the record, this is a critical unsupported claim.

criteria.criterion: Record the Providing institution as shown on the record (without following external link), or state not displayed/unavailable
criteria.final_justification: Providing institution is directly visible on the Europeana record page and matches the agent output. No constraint violation (no external link navigation evidenced).

criteria.criterion: Record the Type of item exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output (“painting”) does not preserve the type exactly as displayed; it omits “; Art of painting”. This is an accuracy/transcription failure, so no credit.

criteria.criterion: Record the displayed Rights statement exactly (or state not displayed/unavailable)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported the rights statement as “Public Domain,” which matches the displayed wording in Screenshot 1.

criteria.criterion: Record the Identifier exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
criteria.final_justification: Because the identifier is not shown in the screenshots and the agent’s reported identifier appears both unsupported and potentially mis-transcribed, this is a critical error.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (no external link navigation, no creator inference, no substitution, stop after six fields) and handle missing/blocked data appropriately
criteria.final_justification: Agent respected the main procedural constraints (no external link navigation shown; no creator inference; stopped after six fields). However, it still asserted unsupported values for missing fields; this is handled in the specific field criteria rather than as a separate constraint violation here. Overall constraints compliance is mostly met.
